error.api_key_missing: NAVER_APIHUB_CLIENT_ID / NAVER_APIHUB_CLIENT_SECRET are not configured. These are the NAVER API HUB keys from the NAVER Cloud Platform console, not the older developer-centre keys.
error.query_required: data.query field is required. (Only the search action needs it; the DataLab actions ignore it.)
error.keyword_groups_required: keywordGroups array is required. Format: [{groupName, keywords}].
error.category_required: category array is required. Format: [{name, param:["category code"]}].
error.category_code_required: categoryCode field is required (field name is "categoryCode", e.g., "50000000"). Main categories: 50000000=Fashion, 50000003=Digital, 50000006=Food.
error.category_code_required_breakdown: categoryCode field is required (field name is "categoryCode"). Main codes: 50000000=Fashion, 50000003=Digital, 50000006=Food.
error.keyword_array_required: keyword array is required. Format: [{name, param:["keyword"]}].
error.search_type_retired: "{{type}}" ({{label}}) search was retired on 2026-07-31. It was excluded from the NAVER API HUB migration and has no replacement, so even existing keys cannot call it. For shopping demand use shopping-categories / shopping-keywords (shopping insight), or naver-ads keyword-tool.
